summary: RonanRx welcome tooling must distinguish the HTTPS front-door URL from the sms: handoff URI and preserve patient-first no-send semantics.
reason: A published web URL can be mistaken for click-to-text unless the CLI exposes the required browser contract, validates safe params, and blocks real outbound preflight without inbound evidence.
validated_outcome: go test ./... passes and invite-link returns front_door_link, sms_uri_preview, first_sender=patient, and outbound_send_performed=false.
